about_the_game:
Batta Batta
Game Introduction
Welcome to the distant world of discarded objects, where the old and worn-out envy the new.
One day, the discarded items kidnapped the beloved Princess Smartphone, known for her charm!
You become an ordinary yet special battery, setting off on an adventure to rescue the princess!

◆ Ride Electronic Devices for Action

  • Hop on electronic devices to unleash unique abilities.

  • Use the distinct powers of each device to fight your enemies!

◆ 2D and 3D Perspective-Switching Puzzles

  • Seamlessly switch between 2D and 3D views during your adventure.

  • Change your perspective to carve out new paths and overcome obstacles!

◆ Adorable and Charming Characters

  • Meet cute and lovable characters in the world of objects!

This project was created with the intent of building a portfolio. Development became progressively challenging due to various circumstances, such as team members' job seeking and preparations, leading us to conclude the narrative much earlier than initially envisioned. Should you have the opportunity to play and provide a review, it would significantly contribute to the planning of future projects and my ongoing studies.
